summary: 18-year-old snowboarder from Gunnison ducked a ski-area boundary rope seeking a shortcut between lifts and became lost in backcountry below the lifts on the East River side; set off and was carried by a small avalanche, crossed the river twice, and dug a snow cave overnight; spotted by a snowcat operator about 8 p.m. and picked up uninjured
location: Backcountry below Crested Butte Mountain Resort lifts, East River side
responding_agency: Crested Butte Mountain Resort ski patrol; Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Mt. Crested Butte police
notes: CBN published 2011-03-02 (incident 'last Saturday, February 26'); snowcat sent to valley floor triggered a 600-ft avalanche during recovery, no injuries
